subject: Decision hypotheses and test plan for POC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Ortiz <danielle@medisync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision hypotheses and test plan for POC

Danielle — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a pragmatic test plan so we can make a head-to-head decision next month. I kept this short and actionable.

Top pain points you reiterated:
- Model latency spikes on peak loads (p95 often > 300ms) that impact user engagement.
- Cost unpredictability with current provider when usage scales up.
- Need for strict data segmentation across tenants and a clear audit trail for PHI-handling flows.

Agreed success metrics (decision hypotheses):
1) Stable p95 latency < 150ms at 75 concurrent requests per node.
2) End-to-end cost per 1K tokens at or below current provider by >= 10% after batching/kv-cache.
3) KV cache hit-rate >= 60% for our conversational workflows (to validate cache benefit).
4) Evidence of controls: SOC2 scope for inference, per-request audit logs, and KMS integration.

Proposed POC/test plan (timeline + owners):
- Week 1: Baseline run vs Competitor X (same prompts, 10k sample requests) — owner: Marissa (SSE).
- Week 2: Latency stress window (ramp to 200 RPS) + isolate tail latency — owner: Camila (SRE liaison).
- Week 3: Cost tuning: batch sizes + quantized model variant tests — owner: Jordan (sales/procurement sync).
- Deliverable: POA spreadsheet with raw metrics, head-to-head scorecard, and recommended config for production.

Open questions we need from you to start (please send by Monday if possible):
- One sample dataset (anonymized) and a representative prompt set (~10k rows).
- Target SLA/latency floor you’re willing to accept for launch.
- Any procurement constraints (PO, preferred contract terms) — loop Sam in if useful.

Attachments: POC-Test-Matrix.csv (proposed tests), Redwood-Rates-and-Config.pdf (pricing for Dedicated pools + sample configs).

Next steps:
- Can we lock a 90-minute technical deep-dive next week (Camila + Marissa + your infra team)? I proposed Tue/Wed mornings PT.
- If you confirm the sample data access, Marissa will spin up the first baseline this week.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision hypotheses and test plan for POC

Thanks Jordan — this is exactly what we needed. I’ll confirm internal availability but high level notes: 

Confirmed priorities (ranked):
1) Latency (p95) and predictable tail behavior — absolutely critical.
2) Data isolation / auditability and KMS integration.
3) Cost — favorable but only after latency constraints are satisfied.

Answers to your open questions:
- We can share an anonymized prompt set (we’ll scrub PHI) — target size: 8–12k rows. I’ll put the dataset on a temporary S3 bucket and share a presigned URL by Monday.
- Target SLA: soft target p95 <= 150ms, hard floor 200ms.
- Procurement: Sam is our procurement lead and will handle PO/contract. He prefers a 1-year term with an option to convert to reserved capacity.

Sam — I’ve looped you for contracting; we may need a short non-prod trial addendum.

I’m available Tue 10/6 at 9:30am PT or Wed 10/7 at 11am PT for the deep technical call.

Jordan / Camila — looping internal ops items and my immediate asks so we can start the first baseline run as soon as Danielle shares the dataset.

Ops checklist (summary):
- Provision: temporary Dedicated pool snapshot (2x A10G nodes) under deal HS-98765 — request to infra.
- Telemetry: enable per-request audit logging and export to the test S3 (format: jsonl).
- KV cache: enable LRU window and sample tracing to measure hit-rate per convo.
- Load harness: I’ll use our existing Gatling scenarios; need the presigned URL and a service account with read-only S3 access.

I attached a short checklist (test-ops-checklist.md) with command snippets and the exact metrics we will collect (p50/p95/p99, tokens in/out, cache hit-rate, cost per 1k).

I’ll own Week 1 baseline and coordinate with Camila for the ramp tests. Jordan — can you confirm procurement cadence with Sam and whether we should propose an addendum for a 30-day trial?

2) Dataset access: please share the presigned S3 URL and a brief README of the anonymization steps so we can match tokens to your real prompts.

4) Baseline delivery date: Marissa will run Week 1 baseline within 3 business days of dataset receipt and will upload the raw metrics to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCdocs
